mapper.select: SELECT * FROM organization WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization(user_id, name, address, color, remark) VALUES(#{userId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{color}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE organization SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, color = #{color}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM organization WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
